name: Burhan Muzaffar Wani
portrayed_by: Likely retain real name; poster boy militant archetype
real_life_parallel: Hizbul Mujahideen commander; killed July 2016; triggered Kashmir unrest

biography.background: Hizbul Mujahideen commander who became social media poster boy for new generation militancy in Kashmir. Avoided direct violence for years, building online following. Killed in encounter July 8, 2016.
biography.social_media: Facebook/YouTube videos without mask; viral following; 'new militancy' symbol
biography.death_impact: Killing triggered months of unrest, stone-pelting, curfews, pellet injuries; 100+ civilian deaths
biography.film_relevance: Part 3 opening: Radicalization backdrop; youth militant recruitment; Zakir Musa arc
